response.original_title: [FAQS-Guide] How do i add another room to My Princess Cruises?
response.overview: To add an extra room to an existing Princess Cruises booking, you must book a separate new stateroom and call customer service at +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK), or contact your travel agent, to link the new reservation to your current booking. This cannot be done directly on the website. Reach out to Princess Support or your travel advisor to have the separate booking numbers linked. To add a separate second room to an existing Princess Cruises, you must book a new, separate stateroom and then contact Princess Cruises (+1-866-829-1280 in the US/Canada) or your travel agent to link the reservations, as this cannot be done directly online. Call support: Contact Princess Cruises or your travel advisor to link the new reservation number with your original booking for synchronized dining and details. To add a room to an existing Princess Cruises, you cannot complete the request online.
